item.title: This New Linux-Based Desktop Operating System Is Built for AI Nerds
item.description: Built by Cyanogen’s cofounder, Kora is a next-gen alternative to Windows and macOS built for power users running local AI models.

item.title: Tear Down Those Guardrails! Meet the Renegades Freeing Chatbots From Corporate Enslavers
item.description: The “abliterators” are flooding the internet with AI models that never say no, making it easier for people to improve their cyberdefenses—or build a bomb.

item.title: The AI Safety Debate Has Lost the Plot. We Asked 10 Experts What the Real Nightmares Are
item.description: The risk of nuclear catastrophe is real, as is the fallout of the China–US domination game (hi there, spies). But no need to panic about Skynet.

item.title: Security Flaws Across UK Government Sites Exposed ‘God-Tier’ Information
item.description: A researcher’s trawl through publicly available code found private information was at risk across multiple departments.

item.title: A New AI Tool From Google DeepMind Proved the Signal Protocol Is Secure
item.description: DeepMind researchers were able to formally verify that the widely used encryption protocol works as intended. Their stretch goal? Do the same for “all the software of the world.”

item.title: Jensen Huang’s Troubles Leave the AI Industry Reeling
item.description: With a big checkbook and sought-after chips, Nvidia’s CEO had his thumb on the world of AI. An extramarital affair with a suspected Chinese spy may put all of that at risk.

item.title: Jensen Huang Hired a PR Firm Known for Handling Sex Scandals Last Year
item.description: The Nvidia CEO began working with consultants from Heller as early as October 2025, around the same time he was first linked to a suspected Chinese spy.

item.title: Authors Can Defend Against AI Allegations With ‘Paper Trail’ Tools. Is It Enough?
item.description: As the publishing industry wrestles with paranoia over the provenance of manuscripts, writers are caught in an impossible bind.

item.title: Bikers and Bug-Lovers Join Forces to Fight a New Google Data Center
item.description: As data center protests break out across Europe, a mismatched band of campaigners is trying to block Google from building a sprawling new facility east of London.

item.title: I Used NYT Cooking’s New AI-Powered Recipe Modifier, and It’s Actually Pretty Good
item.description: The New York Times has added a beta feature to its Cooking app that helps readers swap ingredients or adjust recipes to suit their needs. It mostly hits the mark.
